title: Sulfur Blob
description: Introducing the featureless Sulfur Blob, perfect for punting around without any hard feelings!
body:
# Sulfer Blob

Do you feel sorry for the poor sulfur cubes as you punt them around in your heartless minigames? If so, this is the pack for you! 

Introducing, the featureless "Sulfur Blob", perfect for punting around with no hard feelings!

This pack changes the entity texture, bucket texture, _and_ all of the language keys to achieve full cube-erasure.
